title: Cardiovascular AMBER: re-check and monitor
todo: Content drafted by the team, NOT medically reviewed. Must be reviewed by a flight surgeon / NASA HRP source before any real use. Add source_title/source_url when verified.

n1.text: Do you have chest pain, fainting, or severe shortness of breath right now?

n2.text: Stop all activity, alert a crewmate, and contact the flight surgeon immediately. Do not wait for the next comm window.

n3.text: Rest seated for 10 minutes, then repeat the measurement with the sensor re-seated.

n4.text: Review hydration, caffeine, and today's exercise load.

end.text: If this stays AMBER for 3 more days, include it in your next summary for the flight surgeon.
